answer: Operator Title Forfeiture. Each agent identity is bound to a registered operator title that carries a shared collateral pool. When any one identity is caught in a sybil cluster, enforcement seizes the umber of the entire title, not just the offending wallet. Attackers must forge a distinct title per identity, and each new title raises their minimum locked amount by a fixed delta. The cost scales linearly with identities, so a thousand-wallet attack pays a thousand times the single-title collateral.
